about.en: The Ornn Compute Price Index for the NVIDIA H100 (OCPI-H100) is the hourly price of renting one H100 GPU, in USD per GPU-hour, published by Ornn AI from settled compute trades rather than advertised rates and updated hourly; ICE has announced GPU compute futures referenced to the OCPI series. OKX lists the H100-USDT-SWAP perpetual on it (its H100-USDT index weights Ornn's H100/USD at 50% and Lighter's H100 oracle at 45%). It is an index reference, not a token, chip or claim on compute, and a different benchmark from the Silicon Data H100 Rental Index (SDH100RT).
